attBesluta.text: Perfect for my markets, saving me so much table space

These are a great display item for market stalls. Easy to assemble, nice and light to carry and easy to set up the display. Would've been better to get more hooks with them as vevor don't sell them as an extra.

These walls are fantastic. Really light and portable. Easy to assemble and disassemble- and display hooks are great - I could hand many things at my market display on them while still having space on my display table

I bought 4 of these for a market stall selling bags and they made displaying my wares so professionally. They were light and easy to carry and proved a major asset to my stall. I ended up bying another 4 so I can display more stock, I would highly recommend these. They are fabulous and quite cheap compared to others I have seen.
Bon rapport qualité prix. Un peu leger mais pour un stand sur un marché c'est trés bien.
Grate item value for money made my complaint exhaust system

If your looking to build your own exhaust this kit has everything you need,I build a complete dual exhaust for my 80 Malibu from the headers all the way back to full tailpipes and still had enough pipe and bends left that I could have made full front pipes if I wasn't using headers,highly recommend this kit
très utile pour modifier et/ou réparer mes échappements

Really happy with what I received in the box, it was exactly as described and well packaged. I used less than half of what I ordered to make my own exhaust on a Toyota mini truck, from header to tail pipe. Just used a Mastercraft 120V flux core welder to do the job.
